turns.speaker: Steve
turns.text: Certainly! Imagine stepping into a virtual world where all external stimuli cease to exist, leaving behind an emptiness so profound it’s almost tangible. The air feels strangely dense, as if you’re suspended in an echoless void. There’s no hum of distant machinery, no rustling leaves, no distant traffic. It’s as though the very fabric of sound has been stripped away, leaving a stark, absolute quiet. In this silence, even your own thoughts seem muted, barely discernible, like whispers in a vacuum. It’s a paradoxical experience—feeling both utterly alone and strangely present, as if the quiet itself is a living entity surrounding you.
